title: Order Confirmation
content: Build order confirmation page. Success header: large checkmark, "Order Confirmed!" message, order number. Summary: ordered items list with images, quantities, prices. Totals: subtotal, shipping, tax, order total. Shipping info: address, method, estimated delivery. Next steps: create account prompt (if guest), tracking info coming email. Actions: "Continue Shopping" button, "View Order" link.

variants.simple: Create order confirmation page with summary and next steps.
variants.detailed: Build order confirmation page. Success header: large checkmark, "Order Confirmed!" message, order number. Summary: ordered items list with images, quantities, prices. Totals: subtotal, shipping, tax, order total. Shipping info: address, method, estimated delivery. Next steps: create account prompt (if guest), tracking info coming email. Actions: "Continue Shopping" button, "View Order" link.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive order confirmation page/modal as final checkout step. Success hero: centered content with large success icon (animated checkmark in circle, green pulse), "Order Confirmed!" or "Thank You for Your Order!" heading (text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold), order number prominently displayed (font-mono, copiable), "Confirmation sent to [email]" note. Order summary section: bg-white rounded-lg shadow-sm p-6. Items list: each item shows image (w-16 h-16), name, variant details (size, color), quantity, price, link to product for reordering. Order totals: subtotal, discount applied (if any), shipping cost and method, taxes, order total (font-bold text-lg). Payment info: last 4 digits of card used, payment status (Paid, Pending). Shipping information: shipping address formatted, shipping method selected, estimated delivery date prominently displayed ("Estimated Delivery: January 15-17, 2024"), delivery instructions if provided. Tracking section: "You'll receive tracking information at [email] when your order ships" message, tracking number (if available immediately), "Track Order" button (disabled until shipped). Guest checkout prompts: if guest, "Create an Account" CTA to save order history and speed future checkouts, benefits list (track orders, save addresses, faster checkout), email pre-filled. Next steps list: numbered or bullet list explaining what happens next (1. Order confirmation email sent, 2. You'll receive shipping confirmation with tracking, 3. Package arrives!). Actions: "Continue Shopping" primary CTA, "View Order Details" link to order history if logged in, "Print Confirmation" button. Cross-sell: "You might also like" related products section (don't be too aggressive). Social sharing: "Share your purchase" optional (if not gift). Survey/feedback: optional one-question survey ("How was your checkout experience?"). App download: if mobile app exists, prompt to download for order tracking. Order support: "Questions about your order?" with contact link, FAQ link. Email preview: note about what to expect in confirmation email. Mobile: optimized for screenshot sharing, clean layout. Accessibility: success announced to screen readers, order number easily selectable, logical heading structure.
